headline: Senate declined to advance a resolution that would have blocked a proposed U.S. military sale to Israel.
what_it_does: This joint resolution would have blocked a specific proposed sale of U.S. defense equipment and services to the government of Israel. Congress can use this kind of resolution to disapprove arms sales that the executive branch has proposed. The Senate voted on April 15, 2026, not to take it up or end debate, so the sale was not blocked by this measure.

who_it_affects.how: It would have been prevented from buying the specific defense items and services covered by the proposed sale.

who_it_affects.group: U.S. defense companies involved in the sale
who_it_affects.how: They would have lost the business tied to this particular sale.

who_it_affects.group: The executive branch (State and Defense Departments)
who_it_affects.how: It would have been barred from carrying out this proposed foreign military sale.
